_note: Where the VACC is and which shares it mounts. Tracked on purpose, so a clone knows the lab-wide facts. Who you are on it is NOT here: that lives in GUI_logs/.vacc.json, which git ignores.
_path_map: A share this lab keeps recordings on, and the path the cluster mounts it at. Measured: 2732 of 4574 recorded paths are on bigdata_jbarry, so most recordings need no transfer at all. A drive letter is NOT a rule here -- Y: means different things on different machines and is discovered per machine.
